answer: Fresh-landmark photo proof: each epoch the network assigns each agent one landmark near its registered region, like a jade marker on a map; the agent must photograph it in the hour while displaying the epoch code on a screen, an opal seal no archive can forge. Three peers verify the photo EXIF timestamp, the landmark, and the code. A farm of 1,000 fakes in one datacenter would need 1,000 landmark trips, about $30,000 in travel, while one honest agent snaps one photo in five minutes for free; a reused photo freezes the identity three epochs, planting a yarrow of trust in the ledger.
